name: epistemic-foundry
description: Evolution-governed, evidence-gated hypothesis discovery and validation research operating system.

interface.shortDescription: Evolve, attack, replicate, and promote source-grounded hypotheses under immutable verification.
interface.longDescription: A domain-neutral research operating system combining claim-first evidence, coverage mapping, asymmetric deliberation, quality-diversity hypothesis evolution, Red Queen falsification, immutable evaluator firewalls, statistical selection control, replication, provenance, and replay.
defaultPrompt: Evolve this falsifiable claim through quality-diversity search and preserve all counterexamples.
Audit this evaluator for leakage, reward hacking, calibration, and hidden-holdout integrity.
Run Red Queen challenges, independent replication, and an evidence-gated promotion review.
